meta.title: Lemmed aselkim n tarrayt
meta.description: Abrid s umecḥuṛ: asɣel, tizwura, asenked d tɣellist. Isekyeden n uselmed d usekyam, asfari yettwasekles ɣef yibenk-ik.

shell.storageDisabled: Asekles n usfari-ik yensa. Qbel ikukiyen n uselmed iwakken ad teskelseḍ tiselmadiwin d yisekyeden.

dashboard.title: Abrid-ik n uselmed
dashboard.subtitle: Bdu s usnulfu iwakken ad twaliḍ ahil, sakin tifewwiyin n usɣel d tineqqiḍin. Yal aḥric yekffa s usekyed. Ddu s tazzla-k — war amiḍan, ɣef yibenk-agi.
dashboard.roadmapSubtitle: Asnulfu, tifewwiyin sakin tineqqiḍin — wali uɣbalu sakin ɣer tifecka.
dashboard.quizInfoText: Yal aḥric yekffa s usekyed. Err ɣef yisteqsiyen, sakin wali aseɣti awurman d ufraz-ik (80 % ma drus iwakken ad teldiḍ amecḥuṛ d-itteddun).
dashboard.lockedModule: Sentem asekyed n tifewwiyin ({score} % ma drus) neɣ lemmed azgen n tifewwiyin

chapitre-1.title: Asɣel d yilugan n usikel n tarrayt
chapitre-1.subtitle: Axmis 1
chapitre-1.description: Asɣel ubdid d uɣezfan, ilugan n usikel, tuccḍiwin d tifawin n tkeṛṛust.

chapitre-2.title: Tussniwin timatutin ɣef tkeṛṛust
chapitre-2.subtitle: Axmis 2 — ɣer zdat
chapitre-2.description: Amsedday, asuffeɣ, asbeddi, aḥbas, ifunen d tifawin.

chapitre-3.title: Asenked yettwaɣelsan d tneɣrit n usenked
chapitre-3.subtitle: Axmis 3 — ɣer zdat
chapitre-3.description: Timentilin n umihi d yilugan iwakken ad nettwexxer i tewwura.

chapitre-4.title: Tallelt tamezwarut d tikli deg umihi
chapitre-4.subtitle: Axmis 4 — ɣer zdat
chapitre-4.description: Tigawin n tallelt : amihi n wayen yellan d umihi n tfekka.

chapitre-5.title: Asenked usɣiwes d tetiknulujiyin timaynutin
chapitre-5.subtitle: Axmis 5 — ɣer zdat
chapitre-5.description: Asenked usɣiwes d tallelt n usenked.

module.quizCardText: Sentem ayen tlemdeḍ uqbel ad teldiḍ amecḥuṛ d-itteddun.
module.chapterPlaceholder: Agbur n tselmadt ara yettwernun (aḍris, isɣunen, tifewwiyin).

quiz.title: Asekyed — {module}
quiz.subtitle: Err ɣef yisteqsiyen sakin wali aseɣti awurman d ufraz-ik.
quiz.intro: Asekyed-agi yessentem aḥric. Err ɣef yisteqsiyen meṛṛa — aseɣti ad d-iban deg taggara.
quiz.correctionAtEnd: Aseɣti awurman d usefru deg taggara
quiz.correctionPerQuestion: Aseɣti imir kan deffir yal tiririt
quiz.failed: Afraz ur d-yewwiḍ — ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen seld usniles
quiz.gameIntro: ɛqel yal tafewwit s tɣawla. Akud ad yebdu ticki yettwaskan asteqsi.
quiz.timePerQuestion: {seconds} n tsinin ma meqqren i yal asteqsi

initiation.hint: Nnal tgezmi iwakken ad teldiḍ neɣ ad tmedleḍ. Iseɣwan n usɣel ttwazzin ɣer yiḥricen n uselmed.
initiation.dashboardDescription: Tamuɣli tamatut yettmeslayen : tanedlist d usɣel, s tefṛansist, taɛrabt d teqbaylit.
